constellations.summary: Complete off-field Hydro damage and partywide Fanfare damage buffs on HP changes.
Grants 150 Fanfare points immediately upon Burst cast, raising the maximum cap to 400 points (+100% team DMG buff).
Supercharges Fanfare point gain by 250%. Excess Fanfare increases Furina's Max HP by up to 140%, multiplying her personal damage.
Restores 4 Energy whenever Salon Members attack opponents, lowering her Energy Recharge requirement to ~120-130%.
Converts her Normal Attacks into Hydro damage for 10s upon Skill cast, enabling full-team burst healing or massive on-field nuking.
